title: Lingmo OS 5.0 26a17 (Lithium)
content:
## What's New
- New Software Update page in Settings with real-time download and install progress
- Improved system service architecture with UpdateManager
- Performance improvements across the desktop

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed sidebar category grouping in Settings
- Fixed display manager startup sequence
- Fixed font config update on language change

## Known Issues
- This is an Alpha release; some features may be unstable
